rules.title: How to play
rules.step1Body: All players secretly get the same word — except one random imposter, who gets a different word.
rules.step2Body: In turn, each player says one word connected to their word. Don't say a word from the root of the real word!
rules.step3Body: The imposter doesn't know the real word and is trying to blend in. Watch for a clue that feels off.
rules.step4Body: Everyone votes in secret, then all votes are revealed. The most-voted player is out and their role shown.
rules.step5Body: The crew wins by catching the imposter. The imposter wins by surviving. Scores add up across games.
rules.tipTitle: Golden rule: keep a straight face
rules.tipBody: Never react to what anyone says — no laughing, frowning, or "huh?". A reaction reveals whether a word fit, which hands the game to the imposter (or wrongly exposes a friend). Poker faces only!
